{{Top}}
[[File:Credit_Stick.jpg|thumb|right|A credit chip]]
'''Credit chips''', also known as '''credit sticks''', were [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in a form of a small, flat chip or card issued by the planetary government which had values ranging from one to over a billion with a limit set by the issuing governmental authority.

==Description==
Credit chips allowed [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] citizens to access the contents of their credit accounts electronically without the need for hard currency. Resembling a small, flat card, credit chips had an integrated security codeout and memory algorithm stripes that kept track of the amount of credits available to the owner. The chip could either hold a specified number of credits, or be programmed to draw from an account held at a central [[Bank/Legends|bank]]. The algorithms accurately added or subtracted the credits from the available amount as transactions were made. Credit chips allowed for the quick and easy transfer of a user's funds and were designed to protect the account from theft.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Modifying a credit chip was possible though extremely difficult and although it could be altered to access a different account than it was coded for, this was practically impossible. Because of common security countermeasures, a failed attempt to modify the chip activated [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct programming]], destroying the chip.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

==History==
The standardized technology behind credit chips was created and perfected [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. While [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments often still used hard currency, governments that spanned multiple [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] or [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] relied on electronic currency. Because of the popularity and widespread use, few galactic citizens ever saw actual cash as their income was directly deposited into their accounts. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], and [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] relied heavily on electronic currency and credit chips. Sometime after the rise of the Empire, the credit chip was replaced by the [[cred stick]], a pen-sized device.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
